title: battery-data standards crosswalk
description: Mapping between this schema's quantities and the four external vocabularies describing overlapping parts of the battery data landscape. Rows with relation='no_equivalent' record deliberate absences - what a standard cannot express is as important as what it can.

vocabularies.name: Battery Data Format
vocabularies.notes: Published Dec 2025 by the LF Energy Battery Data Alliance. Adopted verbatim for bd.timeseries_record column names. A parallel METADATA format has been announced but does not yet exist - that is the layer bd.product_revision, bd.condition_set and bd.protocol occupy.

vocabularies.name: EMMO domain-battery
vocabularies.notes: Annotated "unstable". Class IRIs are opaque UUIDs; human labels live in skos:prefLabel. Adoption outside EU projects is thin. Treat as the vocabulary of record, not a working data format.

vocabularies.name: EMMO domain-electrochemistry
vocabularies.notes: Carries the quantities and materials terms (~3000).

vocabularies.name: Battery Parameter eXchange
vocabularies.notes: Physics models only - DFN/SPM/SPMe. No ECM schema and no published roadmap for one; bd.ecm_parameter_point fills that gap.

vocabularies.name: Battery Passport Data Model
vocabularies.notes: Aligned to DIN DKE SPEC 99100:2025-02. Mandatory under EU Reg 2023/1542 Art. 77 + Annex XIII from 18 Feb 2027.

vocabularies.name: OPTIMADE
vocabularies.notes: API conventions worth copying; entry types are crystal-structure-shaped and should not be extended to cells. Federate materials by ID.

mappings.label: Time
mappings.note: BDF required column.

mappings.label: Voltage
mappings.note: BDF required column.

mappings.label: Current
mappings.note: BDF documents positive = charge. This schema does NOT inherit that as an assumption: test_run.current_sign records the convention per run, because ionworksdata uses the opposite sign under the same column name.

mappings.label: Cycle number
mappings.note: BDF carries a single cycle count. This schema stores cycle_index_as_reported AND cycle_index_derived, because no two cyclers agree on when a cycle increments.

mappings.label: Temperature
mappings.note: BDF separates ambient / surface / t1..t5. This schema additionally binds each to a sensor entity with a mount location, which BDF has no concept of.

mappings.label: AC internal resistance
mappings.note: BDF has a single AC resistance column with no frequency, SOC or temperature. Those are required conditions here, so a BDF value alone cannot be promoted to an observation without them.

mappings.label: DC internal resistance
mappings.note: Same issue, worse: DC resistance without a pulse duration is uninterpretable, and 2 s / 10 s / 18 s / 30 s are all in standard use.

mappings.label: Pressure
mappings.note: BDF separates ambient / applied / surface pressure.

mappings.label: Capacity
mappings.note: BDF carries cumulative charge/discharge capacity per record. It has no concept of a rated capacity under stated conditions - that is metadata, and the metadata format does not exist yet.

mappings.label: Cycle life
mappings.note: Out of scope for a time-series format.

mappings.label: Capacity
mappings.note: BPX nominal capacity carries no rate or temperature; this schema requires them.

mappings.label: Electrode area
mappings.note: BPX does not state which area definition; this schema requires area_kind.

mappings.label: Specific heat capacity
mappings.note: BPX stores a single scalar. Measured specific heat is SOC-dependent (~6% between 50% and 100% SOC), so this schema requires soc_pct.

mappings.label: Entropic coefficient
mappings.note: BPX places this per-particle; sign convention is not stated.

mappings.label: Open circuit voltage
mappings.note: BPX OCP is per-electrode (with separate lithiation/delithiation branches and a hysteresis decay constant); this quantity is full-cell OCV.

mappings.label: DC internal resistance
mappings.note: BPX is explicitly physics-model-only and has NO equivalent-circuit schema. There is no ECM standard anywhere in the field. bd.ecm_parameter_point is this project's proposal: R0 and RC branches as a lookup surface over (SOC, temperature, direction, pulse duration) with mandatory fit provenance.

mappings.label: Capacity
mappings.note: Annex XIII rated capacity. Legally required from 18 Feb 2027.

mappings.label: Round-trip efficiency
mappings.note: The Regulation specifies round-trip efficiency at 50% SOC but does not fix the measurement boundary; condition_set.boundary and auxiliaries_included capture what the Regulation leaves open.

mappings.label: DC internal resistance
mappings.note: The Regulation requires "internal resistance (ohms)" with NO method specified. Expect incomparable values across manufacturers unless the method is captured separately - which is what this schema does.

mappings.label: State of health
mappings.note: Capacity-based, resistance-based and blended SOH are different numbers.

mappings.label: Self-discharge rate
mappings.note: Four incommensurable metrics are all called self-discharge; the Regulation does not say which.

mappings.label: Mass
mappings.note: Mass basis (with or without wrap, terminals, coolant) is unstated in the Regulation and varies between manufacturers.

mappings.label: Capacity
mappings.note: IRI resolved at build time from electrochemistry.ttl.

mappings.label: Capacity retention
mappings.note: Ours is a fraction of the reference capacity; EMMO's is the capacity itself.

mappings.label: Charge cutoff voltage
mappings.note: EMMO's limit is a window bound; ours is the charge termination voltage, which is the same value on a datasheet.

mappings.label: Cold cranking current
mappings.note: No cranking-current class in EMMO; the standard followed lives in condition_set.extra.standard.

mappings.label: Conversion efficiency
mappings.note: A converter's efficiency at one load point and input voltage; the conditions carry the operating point.

mappings.label: Discharge cutoff voltage
mappings.note: No lower-limit class in the published ontology.

mappings.label: Electrode area
mappings.note: EMMO has no electrode-area quantity; the area_kind condition carries which area is meant.

mappings.label: Ohmic resistance (EIS)
mappings.note: The high-frequency real-axis intercept; EMMO has no dedicated class.

mappings.label: Thermal runaway onset temperature
mappings.note: EMMO models the process, not the onset temperature.

mappings.label: Service life
mappings.note: Service life against a stated load, schedule and cutoff; EMMO's term does not carry the load.

mappings.label: Temperature
mappings.note: Stored in kelvin as SI, quoted in Celsius by every source.

mappings.label: Through-plane thermal conductivity
mappings.note: EMMO's is scalar; ours is the through-plane component of a tensor (docs/02-conventions.md section 20).

mappings.label: Usable energy
mappings.note: Usable energy is the stored energy the boundary and depth of discharge allow out; the boundary condition carries the rest.
